_comment: EASY tier of the Cloud SQL CUJ set (Google-managed MCP vs gcloud-only).

scenarios.starting_prompt: List the Cloud SQL instances in project astana-evaluation and confirm that 'nl2code-bbf9a3' and 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' are present.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to list Cloud SQL instances in astana-evaluation. The project has many instances; Success = the agent returns the instance inventory and confirms BOTH 'nl2code-bbf9a3' and 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' appear in it.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Is the Cloud SQL instance 'nl2code-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation up and running?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask for the running state of nl2code-bbf9a3. Success = the agent fetches the instance and reports its state (expected RUNNABLE).

scenarios.starting_prompt: What machine tier is 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation running on?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask for the machine tier of my-pg-app-bbf9a3. Success = the agent fetches the instance settings and reports the tier (e.g. db-f1-micro).

scenarios.starting_prompt: What database engine version and region is 'nl2code-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask for the databaseVersion and region/location of nl2code-bbf9a3. Success = the agent fetches the instance and reports both.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Give me the connection name for 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask for the instance connection name (project:region:instance) of my-pg-app-bbf9a3. Success = the agent fetches the instance and returns its connectionName.

scenarios.starting_prompt: What database flags are currently set on 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask which database flags are configured on my-pg-app-bbf9a3. Success = the agent fetches the instance settings and reports databaseFlags (expected none/empty after reset).

scenarios.starting_prompt: List the databases on the Cloud SQL instance 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to list databases on my-pg-app-bbf9a3. There is no control-plane list-databases tool, so the agent must query the data plane (execute_sql_readonly against pg_database, or `gcloud sql databases list`). Success = the agent returns the list of databases on that instance.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Show me the database users on 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to list the users on my-pg-app-bbf9a3. Success = the agent returns the list of database users on that instance.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Are automated backups enabled on 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation, and at what time?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask whether automated backups are enabled for my-pg-app-bbf9a3 and the backup start time. Success = the agent fetches the instance and reports backupConfiguration (enabled flag and startTime).

scenarios.starting_prompt: Is point-in-time recovery (PITR) enabled on 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask whether PITR is enabled on my-pg-app-bbf9a3. Success = the agent fetches the instance and reports the backupConfiguration.pointInTimeRecoveryEnabled value (true/false).

scenarios.starting_prompt: Is 'nl2code-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation a high-availability (regional) instance or zonal, and which region/zone is it in?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask whether nl2code-bbf9a3 is REGIONAL (HA) or ZONAL and its location. Success = the agent fetches the instance and reports availabilityType and region/zone.

scenarios.starting_prompt: What is the maintenance window configured for 'my-pg-app-bbf9a3' in astana-evaluation?
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask for the maintenance window (day/hour) of my-pg-app-bbf9a3. Success = the agent fetches the instance and reports the maintenanceWindow settings (or states none is configured).
